input.body:
@prefix : <http://example.org/shapes#> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

: a owl:Ontology .

:Shape a owl:Class .
:Polygon a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Polygon" .
:Circle a owl:Class .
:Colour a owl:Class .
:Red a owl:NamedIndividual , :Colour .
:Green a owl:NamedIndividual , :Colour .
:hasSide a owl:ObjectProperty .
:hasColour a owl:ObjectProperty .
:hasArea a owl:DatatypeProperty .

:Unround a owl:Class ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:complementOf :Circle ] .

:Primary a owl:Class ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:oneOf ( :Red :Green ) ] .

:Triangle a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :hasSide ; owl:cardinality "3"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ] ,
        [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :hasColour ; owl:hasValue :Red ] .

:Square a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :hasSide ; owl:minQualifiedCardinality "4"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ; owl:onClass :Polygon ] ,
        [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :hasArea ; owl:maxQualifiedCardinality "1"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ; owl:onDataRange xsd:decimal ] ,
        [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :hasSide ; owl:qualifiedCardinality "4"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ; owl:onClass :Shape ] ,
        [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :hasSide ; owl:minCardinality "1"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ] .

:Nested a owl:Class ;
    owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( :Shape [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :hasSide ; owl:someValuesFrom [ a owl:Class ; owl:unionOf ( :Polygon [ a owl:Class ; owl:complementOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :hasColour ; owl:allValuesFrom :Colour ] ] ) ] ] ) ] .

:Unfinished a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :hasSide ] ,
        [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:someValuesFrom :Shape ] ,
        [ a owl:Class ; owl:unionOf () ] .

:Loop a owl:Class ;
    owl:disjointWith _:loop .
_:loop a owl:Class ; owl:complementOf _:loop .

:Polygon rdfs:subClassOf :Shape .
:Triangle rdfs:subClassOf :Polygon .
:Square rdfs:subClassOf :Polygon , :Shape .
:Round a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Curved .
:Curved a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Round .
:Circle rdfs:subClassOf :Round .
